page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg5.4xlarge is an x86_64 server instance belonging to the High Clock Speed instance family, built on KVM virtualization. Compute resources are provided by a dedicated Intel Xeon 6149 processor operating at a base frequency of 3.1 GHz, featuring 8 physical cores and 16 vCPUs via hyper-threading. The instance includes 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache per core, and 22 MB of shared L3 cache. It incorporates 64.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance includes no attached GPU accelerators and has no onboard local storage, requiring attached network block storage for persistence.

Benchmark evaluations position the ecs.hfg5.4xlarge within the middle tier for multi-threaded processing and cached data access. In multi-core CPU evaluations, the instance recorded a stress-ng score of 14,412.57 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 6,665.0, alongside a PassMark CPU score of 15,344.86. Memory throughput reached 802.88 GB/sec under small cached block sizes and 72.73 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. Conversely, single-thread performance benchmarks register in the lower quartile, characterized by a stress-ng single-core score of 1,356.18 and a Geekbench single-core score of 1,106.0. Memory writes for uncached 256 MB blocks yielded 36.18 GB/sec, while LLM inference benchmarks showed reduced capacity on medium 7B models.

With a 3 Gbps baseline network interface and no native NVMe or disk storage bundled into the hardware chassis, storage latency depends on network storage attachment. The balanced core-to-memory density provides cost-efficient resource provisioning for parallelized enterprise workloads rather than single-thread-bound compute jobs. Appropriate workloads include mid-tier relational database hosting, Redis cache instances, static web serving, Clang compilation pipelines, and containerized microservice clusters that benefit from dedicated core execution without needing specialized accelerators.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg5.4xlarge is an x86_64 instance from the High Clock Speed family, provisioned with 16 dedicated vCPUs across 8 physical Intel Xeon 6149 cores clocked at 3.1 GHz and supported by 64 GB of RAM. The instance features a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM configuration, 3 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth, zero local disk storage, and no GPU accelerators. In synthetic benchmarks, it demonstrates mid-tier multi-threaded CPU output and memory bandwidth, scoring 14,412.57 in multi-core stress-ng tests and handling 14.17 million Redis SET operations per second, contrasted by weaker single-core benchmark metrics. The absence of local disk requires external cloud storage, making this instance suitable for containerized application tiers, web serving, background compilation jobs, and distributed databases requiring consistent, dedicated hardware allocation.
